title: Office Battlefield - The 23-Word Nuclear Warhead
summary: A colleague's jokes and a Linear ticket become, in Jason's mind, a contest for respect. He calls on Claude to deliver a pointed message in a Slack thread, then breaks down the five layers of strategy he believes it carried.

portal.scene: Jason faces a giant paper message above an office chess table; coworkers, a task ticket, an AI agent and everyday work objects circle the room.

production_status: author-selected full manuscript and board-derived digital portal; print and media pending
